title: Atomic Habits: An Easy & Proven Way to Build Good Habits & Break Bad Ones.
author: James Clear
description: This book provides a step-by-step plan for building better habits by focusing on "atomic habits"—small, 1 percent improvements that compound into remarkable results over time. It introduces a four-step model (cue, craving, response, and reward) and the "Four Laws of Behavior Change" to help readers fulfill their potential by designing systems for success rather than just setting goals
